control-size.$description: New token, ImageViewer's toolbar, arrow and thumbnail-strip button diameter (44px): well above the 24px target-size floor, and a comfortable thumb target on the full-screen stage, where the buttons sit over a photo and need room to be hit.

thumbnail-size.$description: New token, the side of one square thumbnail in ImageViewer's strip: large enough to recognise a photo, small enough that a phone shows several.

caption-max-width.$description: New token, the width a caption may reach before it wraps, so a long caption keeps a readable line length under a wide photo.
